product.remarks:
Access, track & manage your money easily
  • Online Banking:
    • Easy transfers and payments:Transfer funds almost instantly between banks with Fast and Secure Transfers (FAST). Pay any bank's credit card bills online or transfer money locally and to overseas accounts.
    • Track your spending by category:Know exactly where your money is going as your spending is automatically sorted by category Money In$ights.
    • Online security guarantee:Guaranteed a full refund of any money lost due to fraud via Online Banking.
  • Access cash at over 2,000 withdrawal locations islandwide:
    • Convenient locations:All OCBC and UOB ATMs, participating 7-Eleven stores and NETS merchants.
    • Make NETS purchases:Make purchases with your OCBC YES! Card or ATM Card where NETS is accepted.
  • Sunday at OCBC:
    • Open every day at 19 branches from 11am to 7pm:A new banking experience awaits you at our 19 full-service 'Sunday at OCBC' branches.
product.benefits:
Bonus interest on the first S$70,000 of your account balance when you do all or any of these:
  • 1.2% per year - Credit your salary of at least S$2,000 through GIRO.
  • 0.3% per year - Pay at least 3 bills online or through GIRO with a total amount of at least S$150.
  • 0.3% per year - Spend at least S$500 on OCBC Credit Cards.
  • 1.2% per year - Insure or invest with OCBC. Earn 0.6% or 1.2% for 12 months, depending on the qualifying amount.
  • 1% per year - Earn this extra bonus on the first S$70,000 if your account balance is S$200,000 and above
  • You will earn a base interest of 0.05% per year on your entire account balance.
